grammar.0.title: Introducing yourself — in one go
grammar.0.note: The exam asks for exactly these eight lines — practise saying them aloud again and again.
grammar.1.title: A1 grammar at a glance
grammar.1.rows.0.1: In a normal sentence the verb is in second place; in a question it comes first
grammar.1.rows.1.1: -e, -st, -t, -en, -t, -en; irregular: sein, haben, essen, nehmen, fahren, sprechen
grammar.1.rows.2.1: der / die / das; die in the plural; learn words together with their article
grammar.1.rows.3.1: After haben, möchten, brauchen: der → den, ein → einen
grammar.1.rows.4.1: After in, auf, neben, mit, zu: dem / der
grammar.1.rows.6.1: können, wollen, müssen, möchten — main verb at the end
grammar.2.title: What next?
grammar.2.text: This app is for preparation — it does not give a recognised certificate. The official A1 exam (for example Goethe-Institut, telc or ÖSD A1) usually has four parts: Lesen (reading), Hören (listening), Schreiben (writing), Sprechen (speaking). Check the exam date, fee and rules on the website of the exam centre in your city. After that, move on to the A2 lessons.
quiz.1.why: With Sie the infinitive form is used: Wie heißen Sie?
